user.title: Connect to OpenRouter
user.description: Enter an OpenRouter API key. This validates the key and loads the current speech-model catalog; it does not guarantee balance, model access, pricing, or provider availability.

data_description.api_key: Stored in Home Assistant's config entry storage. Do not share it in logs or issue reports.

model.title: Choose a speech model
model.description: Only catalog models with explicit speech output and a confirmed voice mode are listed. The audited Fish Audio s2.1 Pro Free model can use its provider default when supported voices are explicitly null. Free and price information is a current snapshot, not a cost guarantee.

voice.title: Choose voice and defaults
voice.description: The model and voice are validated and saved together. Provider default voice means the voice field is omitted from the upstream request. Files below www are exposed through /local and may be accessible without authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect OpenRouter TTS
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was rejected. Enter a replacement key. This does not revoke the old key in OpenRouter.

error.access_denied: This API key is not allowed to access the required OpenRouter endpoint.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to OpenRouter. Check the network and try again.
error.read_timeout: OpenRouter did not respond in time.
error.rate_limited: OpenRouter rate limited the request. Wait before trying again.
error.server_error: OpenRouter or an upstream provider is temporarily unavailable.
error.invalid_catalog: OpenRouter returned an invalid model catalog.
error.no_tts_models: No model with confirmed speech output and a safe voice mode was found.
error.model_not_found: The selected model is no longer in this catalog snapshot.
error.model_voice_mismatch: The selected voice is not supported by the selected model.
error.unsafe_path: The storage path must remain inside the Home Assistant configuration directory and cannot contain unsafe components.
error.no_free_models: No verified-free TTS model is available in the current catalog. Select all speech models to continue.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while configuring OpenRouter TTS.

menu_options.configure: Configure model, voice, speed, and storage

configure.title: Choose model display scope
configure.description: Free status reflects only the current catalog and never guarantees future or routed-provider cost. Changing this filter does not change saved speech settings until the final step is submitted.

model.title: Choose a speech model
model.description: Unavailable saved models may be shown only so an existing selection is not silently replaced.

voice.title: Confirm voice and defaults
voice.description: All values on this page are validated and saved atomically. Provider default voice omits the upstream voice field. A speed field is sent upstream only when explicit capability metadata supports it.

refresh.title: Refresh catalog
refresh.description: Fetch current speech capability, voices, availability, and pricing metadata. Speech is not generated and no billable generation request is made.

error.invalid_auth: OpenRouter rejected the API key. Start reauthentication.
error.access_denied: This API key cannot access the required OpenRouter endpoint.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to OpenRouter. The last good catalog remains available where possible.
error.read_timeout: OpenRouter did not respond in time.
error.rate_limited: OpenRouter rate limited the catalog request.
error.server_error: OpenRouter or an upstream provider is temporarily unavailable.
error.invalid_catalog: OpenRouter returned an invalid model catalog.
error.model_not_found: The selected model is not in this catalog snapshot.
error.model_voice_mismatch: The selected model and voice are not a valid pair.
error.unsafe_path: The storage root must be an absolute path inside the Home Assistant configuration directory without traversal.
error.no_free_models: No verified-free TTS model is available now. Return and select all speech models; saved settings were not changed.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while loading options.
